citation.short_title: Melvin-Koushki, The New Brethren of Purity (2025)

content: After Iskandar's defeat and execution at Shāhrukh's hands, the paper says, Ibn Turka sought to cultivate his patronage in turn with the Query of Kings (Suʾl al-Mulūk), written for Shāhrukh in early 1426 at the instance of Shāhrukh's son Bāysunghur (d. 1434).
